items.title: Unit 4 · Story
items.scene: I don't like to sail on the bay in the ___.
items.prompt: Listen and choose the word.
items.spokenScene: I don't like to sail on the bay in the rain.
items.storyText: Hello! My name is Ray. I like to sail. I sail on the bay. I like to sail on the bay on a hot day. I sail on the bay on a hot day in May. I don't like to sail on the bay in the rain. Do you want to sail with me?
items.why: In “Sail on the Bay”, you hear: I don't like to sail on the bay in the rain. The missing word is “rain”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 3, Unit 4, p.39 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
